description: This file declares interfaces related to a GStreamer dispatcher thread, including factory and thread classes, within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace. It defines abstract classes with virtual destructors and a factory method for creating dispatcher thread instances, along with deleted copy/move constructors and assignment operators to enforce non-copyable semantics.

classes.name: IGstDispatcherThreadFactory
classes.description: Abstract factory class for creating IGstDispatcherThread instances.

classes.name: IGstDispatcherThread
classes.description: Interface representing a GStreamer dispatcher thread.

methods.name: createGstDispatcherThread
methods.description: Factory method to create a new IGstDispatcherThread instance, given a client, pipeline, and IGstWrapper.
